scope: unmerged ordered follow-up patch for the FreeCAD development default C++ DXF importer
nativeBuild: macOS ARM64 headless FreeCADCmd from exact source archive 29bdfe30632e084c0b6d015a1258f0ff75b8ed84fca660cec4e74fd4e2604bb9; AppleClang 21, Qt 6.12, OCCT 7.9.3; prior SOLID OCS patch applied
change: Add WCS 3DFACE dispatch and planar triangle/quadrilateral Part-face construction; default omitted Z to zero and omitted fourth corner to third. Strictly reject incomplete, nonfinite, repeated or malformed coordinates and invalid/repeated flags; explicitly report invisible-edge flags, self-intersecting, degenerate and nonplanar faces without inventing a triangulation. Preserve following entity parsing.

validation.baseline: Native importer with only prior SOLID patch reports all 3DFACE entities unsupported. The proposed upstream regression fails on that baseline.
validation.patched: The actual upstream-style generated-DXF test passes 18 subcases: five valid planar/triangle/default-field cases and 13 explicitly reported unsupported/malformed cases. Each checks a following LINE and source counts. The previous SOLID OCS regression passes with both patches.
validation.nested: Two generated tilted 3DFACE controls in millimetres and inches pass exact analytic WCS vertex checks on the outer App::Link after two 90-degree nested inserts.
validation.application: Ordered patches apply cleanly to the exact source; C++ importer was rebuilt and exercised in fresh isolated FreeCAD documents using Import.readDXF.
validation.oracle: Source WCS vertices and independent analytic insert/unit transform; AutoCAD DXF 3DFACE specification documents WCS corners and group-70 invisible edges.

limits: Both FreeCAD default-importer patches are unmerged. Native execution covers headless Import.readDXF into new documents, not the complete GUI open/insert workflow.
Invisible edges and nonplanar quads remain explicitly unsupported; no renderer or native producer equivalence is claimed.
No Linux/Windows tests of the patched FreeCAD development build, producer-authored fixtures, arbitrary nested transforms, binary DXF, or ACIS qualification.
No fixture files are committed and no phase or format support claim is promoted.
